package.description: Browsing a local copy of LibGen catalog

en-US.description: Browsing a local copy of LibGen catalog
en-US.longDescription:
Libgen Desktop is a Windows application for browsing a local copy of LibGen catalog.
The main (non-fiction), fiction and scientific articles (scimag) LibGen collections are supported.
en-US.name: Libgen Desktop
